messages:
zoe_fin: heads up  reconciliation flagged 10 vendor credit memos that landed with empty 'memo' fields in NetSuite after last night's vendor-bill sync. finance can't match them to stripe/merchant payouts. can someone check the connector?

mike_eng: on it. I see the vendor-sync job logged "truncate metadata" warnings around 04:07 UTC. looks like our Netsuite adapter dropped the "external_reference" and "source_note" fields when a payload exceeded 1024 chars.

rahul_sre: infra: the worker restarted twice during that window (OOM kill -> restart). vendor-bot shows a retry hump; retries were replayed in bulk which probably surfaced the truncation bug on reapply.

olivia_ops: impact: 10 vendor credit memos (~$6,400 total) missing vendor references so AP automation couldn't auto-apply against vendor invoices. manual review required. collections/AP flagged 4 vendors for follow-up. finance wants CSV of affected NS ids + vendor_emails + original payload excerpts. also need ops approval to temporarily mark these memos as "manual-match-pending" to avoid automated clearing.

mike_eng: root cause: Netsuite adapter had a hard limit when serializing custom fields and would drop keys whose string value length > 1024 without logging which key. upstream payloads sometimes include long merchant notes (payment provider remittance strings with lots of metadata). on replay the trimmed memos lacked the external reference used by AP rules.

zoe_fin: can we get a list fast? AP wants to avoid double-payment. also request approval to pause AP auto-apply for vendor-credit memos created between 04:00-04:15 UTC.

olivia_ops: approve pause for that window and manual-match tagging. :white_check_mark: add audit comment referencing this thread.

mike_eng: mitigation pushed: 1) feature-flag adapter to fail conversion when custom-field length > 1024 (so we notice) 2) increase the custom-field limit to 4096 in serializer with a safe truncate-and-log fallback for now 3) quarantine replay batches from 04:00-04:20 to a review queue. deploying now.

vendor-bot: Alert: worker restart window 04:05:12-04:09:58 UTC, restart_count=2, replay_batches=6.

zoe_fin: please drop CSV to /shared/finance/vendor-sync/2312345678-missing-memos.csv with fields: ns_memo_id, vendor_email, amount, created_at, original_external_reference_snippet, note="manual-match-pending". finance will review and authorize manual-match operations.

mike_eng: sample offending payload fragment we used to test serializer fix:

```json
{
  "vendor": "vendor_abc@example.com",
  "amount": 3200,
  "external_reference": "remittance:invoice=INV-2024-0001;notes=... very long merchant remittance data ...",
  "source_note": "Payment details: ACH trace id ... [very long string]\nmore lines..."
}
```

mike_eng: note - for backfill we'll replay only events where the external_reference hash matches a Stripe payout id and where NS doesn't already have a memo. we'll create a staging table with proposed matches for finance signoff before applying. ETA: serializer flag + CSV in ~30m, dry-run backfill in ~2h.

rahul_sre: added alert: if any custom-field truncation occurs >0 in future runs, page oncall and pause replay. logging turned on for truncated key names.

zoe_fin: thanks. once CSV is uploaded finance will triage and confirm manual-match apply. keep messages short here please.
